name: BattleEffect_FindMatchingEvent
domain: Finds the first runtime event record matching an effect flag set, actor group, action validity, range window, and selected value mode.
expressed: derives the reference, selected, and alternate values from the current effect context
walks the terminated array of 12-byte event records
filters command kind, action validity, optional cyclic range window, and actor group
supports the special flag mode that bypasses the ordinary masked-flag comparison
applies unconditional, selected-value, or alternate-value matching and returns the first accepted record

bounded_search.reason: The complete readable candidate is eight bytes short with 136 differing halfwords and 147 wrong instructions, outside exact-extent and <=20-halfword admission.

notes: Independent object analysis bounds this owner at 292 executable bytes and proves all 244 relocation-normalized core bytes identical across the six approved GS1 editions.
Typed recovery uses the canonical assembly's 0x02000240 context word; the workbench symbolizer's 0x02000434 rendering was rejected as misleading local evidence.

The residual spans the full predicate-chain control shape and register allocation rather than a localized compiler hunk. No full search or permanent classification was warranted, and zero DONE bytes are claimed.

Recovered only from retained owner assembly, approved local GS1 ROM correspondence, recovered battle-effect callers 080983a0 and 08098cd8, and the approved compiler. No GS2 evidence or external source was used.
